title: Gravitee · Gateway Fleet & Runtime
description: Gateway nodes, inbound and outbound (backend) HTTP traffic, connection pools, JVM memory and GC, threads, CPU and file descriptors.

panels.title: JVM uptime
panels.description: Time since the youngest node started — a low value means a recent restart.

panels.title: Active client connections
panels.description: Open HTTP connections from consumers to the gateway, per node.

panels.title: Backend requests by status
panels.description: Calls the gateway made to upstream services (Vert.x HTTP client).

panels.title: Backend response time
panels.description: Upstream response time measured by the gateway's HTTP client (all backends).

panels.title: Backend connection pool
panels.description: Open connections and in-flight requests per backend. A pool pinned at its maximum while latency rises = backend saturation.

panels.title: GC pause time (per second)
panels.description: Seconds spent paused in GC per second of wall time. Sustained > 0.05 hurts tail latency.

panels.title: Direct / mapped buffers
panels.description: Off-heap buffers used by Netty / Vert.x I/O.

panels.title: Open file descriptors
panels.description: Sockets count as files. Compare with process_files_max_files.

panels.title: Heap used % per node
panels.description: From the gateway's built-in monitoring reporter (gravitee-monitor-* index).
